the LNG industry is booming

. In August, U.S. exports of liquefied natural gas reached a record-high 9.3 million tons. In late July, developer Venture Global announced it had secured $15 billion in financing and would commence construction of its CP2 project in Louisiana, which will be the country’s largest LNG facility once completed. That was the third new LNG project to announce it had lined up enough financing to start building thus far in 2025, and industry analysts expect more to come before year’s end.
